# Pavel Bushuyeu

> Graduate AI researcher at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa, Department of Information and Computer Sciences. Works on vision-language-action models for humanoid locomotion and manipulation in Prof. Igor Molybog's lab. Prior career in software product management.

Site: https://bushuyeu.com
Contact: pavelbushuyeu@gmail.com
Profiles: https://linkedin.com/in/bushuyeu · https://github.com/bushuyeu · https://huggingface.co/bushuyeu · https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=ub3osgUAAAAJ · https://orcid.org/0009-0009-7183-6714 · https://www.semanticscholar.org/author/2405429742 · https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Pavel-Bushuyeu

## Research

- Fiatlux: A Long-Horizon Benchmark for Humanoid Ladder Climbing and Light-Bulb Replacement (arXiv:2609.38216, 2026). Co-first author. A Unitree G1 benchmark in NVIDIA Isaac Lab with baselines from RSL-RL PPO to GR00T N1.7. Project page: https://fiatlux-bench.github.io
- Data-Efficient Curation for Multimodal Reasoning under Fixed Training Protocols (arXiv:2601.10922, 2026). Co-first author. Workshop paper at the Efficient Multimodal Question Answering workshop, ICML 2026.
- First place, Data Curation for Vision Language Reasoning (DCVLR) challenge, NeurIPS 2025 (https://dcvlr-neurips.github.io), with Yosub Shin, Michael Buriek, Boris Sobolev, Vikas Kumar, Haoyang Xu and Samuel Watson.
- ShepBERT: an OMOP-portable EHR transformer for multi-cancer risk prediction in Native Hawaiian and Pacific Islander-serving health systems, with the University of Hawaiʻi Cancer Center. Preliminary results presented at the UH Cancer Center × Google Cloud AI Research Workshop 2026; poster: https://bushuyeu.com/media/shepbert-poster-2026.pdf
- NSF NRT-AI DESCARTES fellowship, 2026.
